## Change and scope

Describe the problem, changed behavior and affected paths. Link an existing issue if useful.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Separate source checks, offline tests, authorized
live model evidence, browser checks and hosted CI. Explain checks not run.

## Evidence and safety boundaries

Does this change affect source selection, evaluation, retention, usage reporting,
execution permissions or public disclosure? State any changed assumptions.

- [ ] I reviewed this patch and attachments for credentials, OAuth files, raw prompts and private source.
- [ ] I preserved unrelated changes and documented remaining limitations.
- [ ] I have not treated local tests or a built artifact as proof of a live run, deployment or release.

## Remaining work

List open findings, compatibility limits and any separate authorization needed.
